units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 12a:11">B. Bath. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>דוולא</he> … <he>בי ד׳ יומא</he> Rashi (ed. <cite ref="D00025"><he>דָּאלוּ</he></cite>, Ar. <he>בדלי</he>) a well can be divided between heirs only when there is for each enough for one day’s irrigating work.—Pl. <cite ref="D00817"><he>דַּלְוָותָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Gittin 74b:12">Gitt. 74ᵇ</cite> <he>דלו תלת ד׳</he> irrigate three times a year.
